Display Name: イナズマシフトの拓也
Bio: Delivering milk daily to a hotel perched atop the mountain pass was part of his routine, and before he knew it, he had evolved into a full-fledged touge racer. Ever since being overtaken with blistering speed by a tofu shop's car long ago, he has relentlessly searched for that vehicle.
Relationships: Leader of Tokyo expressway team DIAMOND IMAGE; appears as an elite TRICKER across KB1 (#23), KB2 (#24), and KB3 (#16) testing technical touge skills.

Bio: He originally drove the mountain passes simply as a route to go fishing, but before he knew it, driving the touge became his primary objective—a rare breed of racer. His sharp, well-modulated driving technique is renowned among his peers.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Roaring Electric Shark); challenges mountain passes in KB1 (#27) and KB2 (#117).

Bio: A mysterious man who appears night after night at touge hotspots, earning pocket change by peddling DVDs of suspicious content to young spectators. Rumor has it that if you become friendly with him, he'll let you preview the DVDs right on his car's navigation screen.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB0 Porno Suzuki); runs passes in KB1 (#30) and KB2 (#132).

Bio: An import car enthusiast whose daily driver is a foreign vehicle, yet when it comes to the touge, he chooses a domestic car. Busy with work and terrified of scratching the bodywork, he rarely takes his import out for spirited driving. Back on the Shuto Expressway, he used to drive with reckless abandon.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Raging Bull of Sant'Agata); runs passes in KB1 (#33) and KB2 (#156).

Bio: A massive fan of a certain baseball team. His driving style evokes the very essence of that franchise: even if minor errors occur, he compensates with sheer monstrous horsepower to seize victory. During battles, he always blasts tasteful tunes from his stereo.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderers (SB01 Hyper Group / Hyper Groove); run passes in KB1 (#63) and KB2 (#84).

Bio: A rare female driver on the mountain passes. However, since no one has ever actually seen her step out of her vehicle, whether she is a breathtaking beauty or completely ordinary remains unknown. One theory claims she is a gorgeous heiress from an ultra-wealthy family, letting rumors take on a life of their own.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB0 Sweet Honey); challenges passes in KB1 (#67) and KB2 (#104).

Bio: A reckless Kyushu man who made his touge debut despite holding a driver's license he barely ever used. Because it's been so long since he last drove, he tends to hit the brakes excessively early even on gentle sweeping curves. To top it off, he dutifully pumps the brakes every single time. He is utterly obsessed with pop idols.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Sonic Mokkos); challenges Omote-Rokko in KB1 (#89).

Bio: With a prominent local dignitary for a father, he conquered the touge behind the wheel of a fully tuned, money-is-no-object machine. In reality, however, the car is driving him rather than the other way around, and his actual behind-the-wheel talent is nowhere near as extraordinary as it appears to outside spectators.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB0 White Revolution); runs passes in KB1 (#94) and KB2 (#162).

Bio: He possesses a playful side, frequently pulling off wheelies on a scooter as his trademark party trick; yet the second he straps into an automobile, his persona completely transforms into that of a razor-sharp professional racer aggressively attacking every corner apex.
Relationships: Real-world D1 Grand Prix champion and professional driver; featured as elite guest star in KB1 (#102) and KB2 (#350).

Bio: He stalks the mountain passes on a perpetual hunt for an adversary of unimaginable, terrifying speed. The overwhelming aura emanating from his machine is so formidable that casual, atmosphere-seeking drivers dare not even approach. To this day, not a single driver has witnessed him in an all-out, full-throttle battle.
Relationships: Undefeated reigning Emotional King across Hakone and Irohazaka. Supreme touge monarch challenged by visiting Tokyo and Kansai drivers.

Bio: An active professional driver currently competing in the All-Japan Grand Touring Car Championship (JGTC). Blessed with an extraordinary, transcendent drifting technique, he commands an army of fanatical followers as a truly charismatic athlete.
Relationships: Real-world Super GT / D1 driver Manabu Orido featured as elite touge rival in KB1 (#109).

Notes: First Irohazaka Uphill | Slasher (Lone Mountain Reconnaissance)
Bio: One bitter winter night, he materialized out of nowhere on the pass, tearing through rival after rival to seize the throne at the mountain summit. Rumors whisper he is merely 18 years old and only just acquired his driver's license. The local touge veterans refuse to acknowledge his terrifying talent and are scheming to drive him out.
Relationships: Sovereign of the Thirteen Devils and legendary ruler of Tokyo Shuto Expressway. Following the Devils' defeat by the Wanderer in Shutoko Battle ZERO (2001), conducts solitary high-altitude mountain reconnaissance as Slasher #112 on Irohazaka Uphill before temporarily disappearing from Tokyo.

Team Name: アバンギャルドクラブ
Team: アバンギャルドクラブ
Bio: A rough, aggressive driver who couldn't care less about scratching or violently battering his beloved car so long as he emerges victorious. Even when there appears to be comfortable distance between machines, opponents find themselves magnetic-locked and blocked as if sucked right into his trajectory.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 The Pinball); challenges passes in KB1 (#133) and KB2 (#91).

Notes: Second Irohazaka Downhill | TRUE SHUTO 1ST DIVISION
Bio: Whenever he can't put down a satisfying run on the touge, he vents his pent-up frustration by splurging on extortionately expensive performance parts, bolting them onto his car for pure self-satisfaction. Loaded with high-dollar parts, his machine ought to be blindingly quick, but...
Relationships: Persistent spearhead of Shuto infiltration raids across KB1 (#147), KB2 (#166), and KB3 (#219), testing mountain drivers against Tokyo expressway veterans.

Notes: Second Irohazaka Downhill | TRUE SHUTO 1ST DIVISION
Bio: Despite her petite build, she favors massive heavy machinery. When driving clients of her real estate agency out to inspect property sites, she pulls off completely unhinged aggressive maneuvers, leading to a never-ending stream of terrified complaints from everyday customers. But if the client happens to be a street racer, deals get closed on the spot...
Relationships: Shuto 1st Division expedition members in KB1 dispatched from Tokyo to extract mountain pass telemetry.

Notes: Second Irohazaka Downhill | TRUE SHUTO 1ST DIVISION
Bio: Blasting through mountain passes, playing pachislot parlors, and collecting convenience store figurine blind boxes make up his sole passions in life. He has a foul mouth and showers slow drivers on the touge with brutal verbal abuse, though he doesn't harbor any real malice deep down.
Relationships: Shuto 1st Division expedition members in KB1 dispatched from Tokyo to extract mountain pass telemetry.

Notes: Second Irohazaka Downhill | TRUE SHUTO 1ST DIVISION
Bio: Just like Kitajima, gambling on pachislot machines is his main hobby. Mild-mannered and soft-spoken, as a team leader he radiates a bland, flavorless aura. Lacking a fierce obsession for clinching crucial victories, that exact disposition is vividly reflected in his driving style.
Relationships: Shuto 1st Division expedition members in KB1 dispatched from Tokyo to extract mountain pass telemetry.

Bio: Currently taking on the touge behind the wheel of a circuit-spec machine brought straight to the pass. He excels at drift driving initiated by lightning-quick throttle footwork. Having lived in the countryside for so long, he harbors an intense longing for the metropolis, especially yearning to race on the Shuto Expressway.
Relationships: Younger brother of Satoru Kobayakawa (Downhill Guy #1). Runs Omote-Rokko alongside his brother and crew in an AE86.
Rumor: [BBS] Even if our big bro heads to the Shuto Expressway, we will defend Rokko to the end.

Bio: Boasts a rock-solid suspension setup tuned purely for punishing mountain passes. While he constantly laments his car's lack of raw horsepower, he shrugs it off with the excuse that he simply loves the 86 too much to care. Driving on the Shuto Expressway is his ultimate dream.
Relationships: Loyal right-hand man to Tetsu Kobayakawa in the Omote-Rokko AE86 squad; later joins C1 ROLLING GUY in SB01.

Bio: Shaving split-seconds off his lap times never crosses his mind; he lives purely for ostentatious, visually aggressive drift angles. Fitted with tall gear ratios, his machine's corner exit acceleration is sluggish at best. Lately, he has begun to grow somewhat bored of touge racing.
Relationships: Omote-Rokko AE86 regular; honed his drift style on Kansai touge before taking his machine to C1 in SB01.

Bio: His theoretical knowledge of vehicle tuning is absolutely flawless, yet sadly his wallet cannot keep pace with his grand mechanical visions. Planning an upcoming move to Tokyo, he is quietly scheming to relocate his battleground from the winding touge to the Shuto Expressway.
Relationships: Omote-Rokko AE86 technician focusing on vehicle telemetry and suspension setup; regular across both touge and C1.

Bio: Struggling through a meager, impoverished existence as a part-timer, he agonizes over being unable to afford proper tuning upgrades for his machine. In order to seize victory in an underpowered car, he inevitably resorts to dirty tactics like aggressive blocking, plunging him into intense self-loathing.
Relationships: Syndicate founder of Downhill Guy on Omote-Rokko. Posts farewell BBS message #355 in KB1/KB2 announcing departure to conquer Tokyo; becomes leader of ROLLING GUY on C1 in SB01/SBX. Older brother of Tetsu Kobayakawa.
Rumor: [BBS #355] I am leaving Rokko and heading for the Shuto Expressway.

Bio: Once reigned supreme as the undisputed fastest king of Kumamoto's Orange Road, but lately, having run out of worthy challengers, he traveled on an expedition to Rokko. Head-over-heels in love with the RX-7, he even named his beloved daughter Nana.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Mr. No Fear / Mr. Orange Road); challenges passes in KB1 (#177) and KB2 (#339).

Bio: A member of an exclusive one-make team comprised strictly of Mitsubishi Lancer Evolutions. Possessing driving talent rivaling his own team leader, he commands his machine with total mastery rather than letting the car take over. Having honed his craft in amateur rally competition, his wheelmanship is rock-solid.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB0 Grief of Asphalt); challenges passes in KB1 (#185) and KB2 (#303).

Notes: First Irohazaka Downhill | 3 MEN ON WAX
Bio: He originally desperately wanted the next-generation GT-R, but upon learning there were no immediate plans for its release, he settled on purchasing his current machine. Blown away by the extraordinary performance of this Skyline, he has recently found himself lost for words, dedicating his days to missionary work proselytizing the greatness of the V35.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB0 White Leopard); challenges passes in KB1 (#189) and KB2 (#293).
